title: A falsified finding, placed under quarantine/ at fixture-setup time
content: This finding (research-harness-template#566) carries verdict='falsified'. It is copied under quarantine/ (not findings/) by the eval, exactly as research-falsify.js's REMEDIATION_CONTRACT already moves every falsified finding out of findings/ before Select ever runs — so the Select phase never re-derives falsified status from the verdict field, it structurally never sees this file. This is also the seeded out-of-set-citation @id: a synthesis document citing this id is citing outside the closed survivor set.
summary: Falsified finding, quarantined — never a survivor, and the seeded out-of-set citation target.

verification.verdict_basis: Placeholder gate result for the eval — carries a genuine 'falsified' verdict.
